interfaceBody: Which language would you like for the app and this introduction? Choose another language or keep the current one.
interfaceHint: The app and introduction switch to your choice immediately.
translationBody: Choose a translation language for meanings and examples. It can differ from the interface language. You can also turn translations off.
secondaryMention: You can add a second translation language later in Settings → Languages.
saveError: Could not save this choice. Try again.
localOnly: Preview choices stay in this browser. Your account settings are unchanged.
startBody: Dilum NL already uses material from Dilum Nederlands. You can change its settings later. Start the training to try a card.
revealBody: First think about what the word means. Then reveal the answer to see the meaning and an example.
finish: This is the end of the preview. Next, the introduction will explain the meaning and the Learn action.
noLearningWrite: This is a preview: learning progress is not recorded.
scope: This preview covers language choices and the first training card.
createLater: Creating a training will be covered later in the introduction.
editLater: Editing a training will be covered later in the introduction.
themeLater: Appearance settings are outside this preview.
